root_idea.summary: A root centered on hunger, especially hunger associated with fatigue.
root_idea.development: The core sense is hunger; lexicographic evidence also reports an occasional or unused extension to thirst.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole supplied Quran-attested form group is presented under the normalized noun citation form.

senses.definition: Hunger, especially hunger accompanied by fatigue; a state of severe hunger or famine.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction فِي يَوْمٍ ذِي مَسْغَبَةٍ, it describes a day characterized by hunger, with the fuller lexical nuance of hunger combined with fatigue.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter upon a state of hunger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV verbal usage describing the onset of hunger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thirst, reportedly also understood as thirst accompanied by fatigue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare or unused lexicographic usage, distinct from the established Quranic sense of hunger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Allowed or permitted something to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction مُسَغَّبٌ لَهُ كَذَا, ‘such a thing is allowed or permitted to him.’
